name: firmwareUpToDate
definition: The installed PAN-OS version is at or above the newest release the update server lists for the same feature train (major.minor), hotfixes included.
population: the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The installed version and the update server's release list showing no newer release in the same feature train.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: request system software check reply shape (result/sw-updates/entry/version) is from vendor examples, UNVERIFIED on a real device; the firewall needs a path to the update server or the call errors (Not evaluated). A train that is end of life still reads as current if nothing newer is listed.
